text:
Maya: Quick sync — Demo Day check: registration page, Zoom recording, and post-event nurture. Need owners + a lightweight checklist before tomorrow's dry run. tl;dr: who owns what?
Zack: I can own Zoom config + recording settings. Plan: cloud recordings for host only, alt hosts = @Chris, separate audio files, enable transcription? Zoom auto-transcription is flaky tho.
Maya: Great. Please set cloud recording, one file per participant, enable 'Record transcript' and 'Optimize for 3rd party video editor'. Also set alternative hosts to Chris and Leo.
Zack: Will do. Quick note: set 'Join before host' = off, waiting room on, mute participants on entry. Panelists can be allowed to unmute.
Leo: I'll take post-processing: download cloud recording to GCS, run postproc pipeline, generate transcript, captions, 60s highlight clips, and push to shared folder. Need format: mp4 1080p, AAC audio.
Olivia: I'll do editing + clip ownership. Prioritize: 1) keynote (60s intro), 2) demo snippet (90s), 3) customer quote (30s). Add captions + 1-sentence copy for social.
Chris: I'll wire HubSpot routing: registrants -> 'Demo Day' list, attended -> 'Attended' tag, clip downloads -> trigger nurture sequence. Need final CSV mapping fields: email, company, role, opt_in.
Maya: Registration page updates: short form (email, company, role, timezone), CTA to calendar add, optional consent checkbox 'May we contact you?'. Add UTM params default to 'demo_day_launch'.
Olivia: Can we add an optional 'what do you want to learn' free text field? helps segmentation for follow-up. Not required.
Chris: Yes add it as 'interest' field. We'll map it to HubSpot property 'demo_interest'.
Zack: Zoom config snippet I'm going to apply:
```
cloud_recording: true
transcription: true
separate_audio_files: true
alt_hosts: chris@example.com, leo@example.com
waiting_room: true
join_before_host: false
```
Recording Bot: Note — cloud transcription quality varies; we still run our own ASR in pipeline.
Deploy Bot: Reminder: Cloud recording retention policy = 30 days. If you need longer, set auto-download to GCS after meeting.
Maya: Owner recap: Zack = Zoom + meeting settings, Leo = ingest + transcripts, Olivia = edits + clips, Chris = CRM routing + nurture. I'll own final QA and shipping assets to comms.
Leo: I'll add a folder structure after upload: /DemoDay/2026-06-15/{raw,processed/transcripts,clips,edits} and share link.
Olivia: :thumbsup: Will prepare social cut copy and 3 draft posts. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Chris: I'll create HubSpot list and workflow tonight, will ping when done.
Maya: Perfect. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when config is in place? Quick last thing: include 'consent to recording' blurb in confirmation email.
Zack: :white_check_mark: done (applied settings), will DM the alt host emails to confirm.
Chris: :white_check_mark: HubSpot list created, mapping ready.
Leo: :white_check_mark: GCS bucket + folder created: gs://redwood-demo-day/2026-06-15
Maya: Thanks team. Dry run at 9:30 PT tomorrow. Calendar invite updated. Recording Bot: start cloud recording at host join please :)
Recording Bot: Auto-record trigger is ON for meeting ID 987-654-321. I'll post link after upload.
